title: Log volume
description: Stored log size per app, noisiest first. An app over its budget has its oldest lines trimmed on the hourly sweep, other apps are never touched.
noDefaultBudget: No fleet default budget (set APP_LOG_BUDGET_MB to apply one).
emptyDescription: Once an app writes output, its stored volume shows up here.
maxMbHint: 0 clears the override and falls back to the fleet default.
saveFailed: Could not save the log budget
overBudget: Over budget: the oldest lines are trimmed on the hourly sweep.
trimStillOver: Still over budget, trim again to keep draining.
